code:
Entire borrow -> use -> repay sequence = ONE transaction

A transaction either FULLY succeeds or FULLY reverts.
There is no partial state.

If repay(amount + fee) fails before the tx ends:
  -> the ENTIRE transaction is undone, including the loan itself
caption: Default is mechanically impossible -- it just means the tx never completed.
The lending pool checks its own balance right after this call returns.

code:
A flash loan does NOT create new attack vectors.
It removes the CAPITAL CONSTRAINT on an existing one.

Attacker finds an oracle-manipulation bug:
  no longer needs millions of their own capital
  -> flash loan supplies it for one tx, for a small fee
caption: Several of DeFi's largest exploits used flash loans exactly this way.
